description.en: Adds a given quantity of an item to the player's inventory, by item ID.
ID of the item to add, e.g. "iie0501".
Number of the item to add.
True once the call has taken effect; null if the call was invalid (e.g. too few arguments, or required engine/script state not ready).

example.code:
// Give the player an item
CMND_ADD_ITEM("iie0501", 1);
